scan.title: Scan attendance
scan.subtitle: Hold the organisation's QR code in front of the camera.
scan.cameraDenied: No access to the camera. You can enter the 6-digit code instead.
scan.cameraUnavailable: No camera available on this device. Use the 6-digit code.
scan.manualHint: The organisation shows a 6-digit code under the QR code.
scan.success: You are checked in. This counts towards your integration passport.
scan.successLate: Saved. The organisation still has to confirm this entry.
scan.noUpcoming: You have no activity with attendance running right now.
scan.queueHint: As soon as you are online again we send them automatically.
scan.offlineQueued: No connection. Your scan is saved and goes out as soon as you are online.

scanError.wrongCode: This code does not belong to Ehrenweg or is wrong.
scanError.expired: The code has expired. Ask for the new QR code.
scanError.inactive: No attendance is running for this activity right now.
scanError.alreadyRecorded: You have already checked in here.
scanError.geoTooFar: You are too far from the venue.
scanError.offlineQueued: No connection – the scan is waiting on your device.
scanError.unknown: That did not work. Please try again.

session.title: Attendance
session.startHint: The next screen shows a QR code that changes every {{seconds}} seconds.
session.requireGeoHint: Participants have to be near the venue.
session.geoMissing: No map pin is stored for this activity – the location check stays off.
session.startFailed: The attendance session could not be started.
session.keepScreenOn: Keep this screen open while people are scanning.

review.title: Late and offline scans
review.hint: These scans arrived when the code had already expired. Confirm them if the person really was there.

award.title: Award points
award.hint: Confirmed attendances are written into the integration passport.
award.failed: Some entries could not be written.

noShow.title: Did not show up
noShow.hint: Accepted but did not come. This costs {{ip}} points.
noShow.empty: Everyone who was accepted turned up.
noShow.userWarningTitle: Please cancel if you cannot come
noShow.userWarningBody: You said yes {{count}} times and did not come. Other people are waiting for those places.
noShow.restrictedBody: Because you did not come three times in a row, you cannot sign up until {{date}}. After that everything goes back to normal – we would be glad to see you again.

claim.title: I was there but was not recorded
claim.hint: Upload a photo showing that you were there. The organisation checks it.
claim.notePlaceholder: For example: my phone was dead, I could not scan the code.
claim.photoHint: It is shrunk on your device before it is sent.
claim.photoTooBig: The photo is too large. Please take another one.
claim.submitted: Thank you. The organisation will look at it.
claim.failed: The request could not be sent.

passport.badgesEmpty: You get your first badge after your first attendance.
